pkgmetadata.longdescription:
The SDL3_gfx library provides the basic drawing functions such as lines, circles or polygons provided by SDL_gfx on SDL3 against renderers of SDL3.
The current components of the SDL3_gfx library are:
* Graphic Primitives (SDL3_gfxPrimitives.h, SDL3_gfxPrimitives.c) * Surface Rotozoomer (SDL3_rotozoom.h, SDL3_rotozoom.c) * Framerate control (SDL3_framerate.h, SDL3_framerate.c) * MMX image filters (SDL3_imageFilter.h, SDL3_imageFilter.c) * Build-in 8x8 Font (SDL3_gfxPrimitives_font.h)
